title: Incorrect default exit code
detail: When no exception occurs, `exit_code` remains 1, causing a successful command to exit with status 1 instead of 0.

title: Missing EPIPE handling
detail: The original code exited with status 1 when `errno.EPIPE` occurred. The new code silently continues, potentially leaving the program running without exiting or reporting the error.

title: Incorrect lock state check
detail: The Twisted lock object does not expose a `locked` attribute; it provides a `locked()` method. Using the non‑existent attribute always evaluates to False, causing the code to always acquire the lock twice and potentially deadlock.

title: Missing await on lock acquisition
detail: The lock acquisition is performed without awaiting the returned Deferred, so the code proceeds before the lock is actually held, leading to race conditions.
note: Names the lock acquisition that isn't awaited.

title: Incorrect logic in accept_html property
detail: The property is documented to return True when ``text/html`` is accepted, but the implementation returns True when it is *not* present, effectively inverting the intended behavior and causing callers to receive the wrong result.
note: Says accept_html is true when text/html is absent, which the planted `not in` does.
